items.context: 2026 年布克獎（Booker Prize）公布六強決選名單，曾獲獎的瑪龍詹姆斯（Marlon James）與道格拉斯史都華（Douglas Stuart）再度入圍，普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）也在名單內。獎金 5 萬英鎊，得主將於 11 月 9 日揭曉。
items.thread_text:
2026 年布克獎（Booker Prize）公布六強決選名單，兩位前獲獎者瑪龍詹姆斯（Marlon James，代表作《The Disappearers》）與道格拉斯史都華（Douglas Stuart，代表作《John of John》）雙雙再度入圍；名單中還有普立茲獎得主伊莉莎白斯特勞特（Elizabeth Strout）、科幻文壇老將 M·約翰·哈里森（M John Harrison），以及兩位新面孔盧克肯納德（Luke Kennard）與麗貝卡佩里（Rebecca Perry）。獎金 5 萬英鎊，得主將於 11 月 9 日揭曉——如果詹姆斯或史都華再度奪冠，會是布克獎史上罕見的二度得獎紀錄。

sources.summary: Oscar-winning film-maker Barry Levinson’s docuseries Bucks County, USA examines the political divide in one town in a revealing and infuriating manner Like many teenage best friends, Evi and Vanessa have a penchant for finishing each other’s sentences. Whether enmeshed on a couch or telling a story, one, a red-headed musical theater nerd with a personality nearly as boisterous as her signature puffy skirts, collides with the other, darker in hair and disposition, their speech bubbling with indecipherable affirmations and giggles. In a heady chorus of “duuude” and “no, you!”, it can be difficult to tell where one girl ends and the other begins. Except, that is, at their respective homes. Evi’s mother, Lela, who like her daughter, espouses views considered left of liberal in the US context, speaks in support of LGBTQ students at local school board meetings and advocates for fact-based history lessons. Vanessa’s father, Paul Martino, is a right-leaning venture capitalist who likes to brag about installing school board members by spending $500,000 on local campaigns, an effort triggered by what he saw as unjustified school closures in the wake of the Covid-19 pandemic. Continue reading...
